decisions.key: crate venue-local trade date; operator event dates collapse into it; operator's printed trade date is corroborating evidence
decisions.row: (trade_date, kind, tier, document_id) static ascending slice built by a holidays! macro with five const-eval fences, mirroring revisions!
decisions.coverage: inclusive (first,last) trade-date window mirroring ExceptionCoverage; in-coverage-no-row = audited normal
decisions.early_close_and_wrap_removal: no new mechanism; existing clamp_to_policy and resolve_rule_bounds already correct
decisions.late_open: existing wrapped/unwrapped ssm disambiguation; a session the normal week lacks (2026-06-20 Saturday) is a declared gap
decisions.modified_days: triage against the era profile; identical->normal, close-only->EarlyClose, open-only->LateOpen, else declared gap
decisions.crypto: Closed rows on holiday trade dates drive identity::assign_normal's business-date roll; has_overlay() must include the built-in table or the roll stays dead and the 24/7 family goes dark
decisions.layer: third innermost layer in QueryContext, resolved once per query, applied in resolve_rule_bounds before the caller's DayPolicy
decisions.precedence: caller SessionExceptionSource (explicit Closed/ReplaceSessions only) -> built-in table -> caller DayPolicy clips; compose by tightening; KnownNormal does not suppress
decisions.hot_path: coverage gate: one partition_point over the sorted rows before any trading-day derivation; identity-derived gate window [D,D+1] ordinary, [D-1,D+1] SET, [D,D+18] crypto; proven by a differential gate-soundness test
decisions.tier: T1 preferred, T2 admissible and carried in the row; T3/T4 do not compile
decisions.evidence: docs/evidence/<owner>.md gains a ## Holidays section, one subsection per year, instants quoted in CT and ET as printed, plus a Derived-from column; new fence ties every row date to the file
decisions.venues: CME/CBOT/COMEX/NYMEX tables are the intersection of the families routing to them; disagreement ships no row and is a named gap

root_cause_of_100x: src/calendar/query/schedule.rs:335-348 - with any overlay attached, resolve_rule_bounds runs candle_end_with(Daily) and candle_start_with(Daily) per rule per candidate day (~17-23 us each per B section 7) purely to derive one trade date, against a 167.7 ns baseline is_open

performance_targets.cold_axis_4999_is_open_plus_1_session_cl: <=1.1 ms regular / <=2.2 ms closed (vs ~84 ms at the unfixed 100x)
